scripts.lint:changed: git diff --name-only HEAD | grep '\.gs$' | xargs -r eslint
scripts.push:licence: cd licence-server && NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 npx clasp push --force
scripts.update: git pull && npm install --silent && npm run push:gas
scripts.deploy:all: npm test && npm run push:gas && npm run push:licence
scripts.env:dev: cp .clasp.dev.json .clasp.json && echo 'Switched to DEV — clasp push gaat naar dev-script'
scripts.env:prod: cp .clasp.prod.json .clasp.json && echo 'Switched to PROD — clasp push gaat naar productie-script'
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run env:dev && npm test && npm run push:gas
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run env:prod && npm test && npm run push:gas
